answer:
Here is what I would raise, most important first.

1. Lung nodule follow-up (overdue). The CT you had in the ER on Oct 18, 2025 for your kidney stone also found a 7 mm solid nodule in the lower right lung. The radiologist recommended a chest CT in 6 to 12 months, so by about October 2026 at the latest. I find no chest CT or any mention of the nodule in your later records, and your June 2026 visit notes don't mention it. This is the most time-sensitive item, so ask for the chest CT now.

2. Repeat thyroid tests (overdue). During your March 2026 hospital stay your TSH was 7.9 (high) with a normal free T4. The discharge papers asked for TSH and free T4 to be repeated in 6 to 8 weeks. Your June 15 blood work had no thyroid tests. Ask for them.

3. Water pill (hydrochlorothiazide) doesn't add up. You were admitted in March 2026 with sodium 123, and hydrochlorothiazide was stopped. But the eye clinic's May 14 list, which you reported yourself, still shows it as a daily medicine. Your June 15 sodium was 134, still slightly low, and the June clinic note says to continue current medicines. The clinic notes I can see never mention the admission or the stop. Check with your doctor and pharmacist whether you are still taking it, and make sure the clinic knows about the hospital stay. The pharmacy also still showed active refills on it.

4. Cholesterol and statin. In September 2025 your LDL was 142, HDL 48 and triglycerides 155. You have type 2 diabetes and are 57. Guidelines generally advise a moderate-intensity statin for people with diabetes aged 40 to 75. I see no statin and no repeat cholesterol test. Ask about this.

5. Diabetes care. Your A1c has improved from 6.9 to 6.7 to 6.6, and your eye exam in May 2026 showed no retinopathy (the next one is due May 2027). I find no urine albumin-to-creatinine test, no foot exam, and no record that you attended the diabetes education you were referred to. Your next A1c is due around the 6-month return visit in December 2026.

6. Vaccines. You had flu, Prevnar 20 and the first Shingrix on Nov 8, 2025. I see no second Shingrix dose (normally 2 to 6 months after the first), no 2026-27 flu shot yet, and no COVID, Tdap or hepatitis B vaccine on record. Some of these may have been given elsewhere, so confirm.

7. Kidney stone. The ER advised follow-up in 1 week, and urology if the stone hadn't passed in 2 weeks. I find no follow-up visit, no imaging showing it passed, and the stone is still listed as active.

8. Cancer screening. Your colonoscopy in 2019 was normal, so the next is due around 2029. I find no mammogram or cervical screening in these records. Ask whether they are up to date.

9. Record clean-up. One older hospital export still lists lisinopril as active, though it was stopped in September 2025 for cough. Amlodipine and your other medicines appear in several copies with different dates. Ask your doctor to reconcile the list.

The records can't tell me what happened outside these providers, so some items may already have been handled.
short: Overdue: chest CT for a 7 mm lung nodule found Oct 2025, and repeat TSH/free T4 after TSH 7.9 in March 2026. Please also check whether I still take hydrochlorothiazide (stopped after sodium 123), and ask about statin, urine albumin, Shingrix dose 2, flu shot, and mammogram/cervical screening.
